acceptance_predicates.description: The contract distinguishes a fresh local proxy client key from upstream Codex OAuth and never calls it an OpenAI Platform API key.
A license-compatible bridge is pinned by source, version, digest, protocol surface, and supported credential workflow.
Credential-free fake coverage and an opt-in development spike prove bounded model discovery and one Responses request.
Nested-agent use through Codex app-server is prohibited and cli2key evidence is labeled development-only and unofficial.

definition_of_done: Contract and bridge decision are independently reviewed and merged.
No secret values, auth-file contents, prompts, private paths, or provider bodies enter durable evidence.
Required exact-head and post-merge checks pass.

inputs.description: A user-controlled, locally authenticated official Codex CLI installation.

outputs.description: Pinned development-only loopback Responses bridge contract.

gates.description: The key, protocol, provenance, trust, and methodology boundaries are explicit and tested.
Independent exact-head review and required CI pass before and after merge.
